source_note: ELIE describes itself as a tiny Lucy-inspired skeleton and references Lucy V0.1 Checkpoint 023 architecture style. This file preserves recovered architecture history, not original Lucy source code.
notes: Lucy's original checkpoint files are not present in the current workspace.
ELIE is treated as a smaller reference implementation, not Lucy herself.
Lucy must stay the top-level system; ELIE patterns can be reused only as architecture.
